candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the working student position as Network Development Analyst. Finding patterns in large data sets to support investment decisions is the kind of analysis I enjoy, and helping decide where EV chargers should go is a goal I care about.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I analyse data in Python and SQL, and in industry analysed purchase and production data to support decisions
I rebuilt a manufacturer's dashboard end to end covering OEE, machine efficiency, downtime and yield
I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), a Python LLM application with a Streamlit dashboard, 37 unit tests, CI and a README written for other users

letter.problems_section: I would analyse location and charging data, help find promising sites and support the development of your network planning tool. Geospatial analysis is new to me, and I would learn it quickly with your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Berlin and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
